study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Zhang et al., Journal of Affective Disorders, 2023
study_identification_part.si4_title: Parsing the heterogeneity of brain-symptom associations in autism spectrum disorder via random forest with homogeneous canonical correlation

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Build a normative model of regional GMV in controls to quantify per-case deviations in ASD, then identify ASD subtypes based on homogeneous multivariate brain–symptom association patterns and test whether subtyping improves case–control classification.

rci1_dataset_name.reason: The paper clearly states that data were from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE), and the supplementary materials specify they had participants from both ABIDE I and ABIDE II. The Methods section mentions 'The study analyzed both structural neuroimaging data and phenotypic data provided by the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE)' and preprocessing section states '1094 participants in ABIDE I and 1100 participants in ABIDE II who passed the preprocessing'.
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: The study analyzed both structural neuroimaging data and phenotypic data provided by the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) (Di Martino et al., 2017; Di Martino et al., 2014)... We had 1094 participants in ABIDE I and 1100 participants in ABIDE II who passed the preprocessing
rci1_dataset_name.location: Zhang2023.pdf.md: Methods / Participants, L83-L86; Methods / Neuroimaging preprocessing, L89-L90

rci2_hc_n.reason: Final included controls after preprocessing/QC and inclusion criteria are reported as 1146.
rci2_hc_n.supporting_text: Finally, the data from 1146 controls and 571 cases entered the following analyses.

rci5_imaging_modality.reason: Abstract and Methods state T1-weighted MRI used; VBM used to compute GMV.
rci5_imaging_modality.supporting_text: T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging … Voxel-based morphometry (VBM) was used to compute gray matter volume (GMV).

nm1_model_origin.detail: The paper describes fitting a new normative model using the control participants from ABIDE. The Methods section states 'we fitted a multivariate linear regression model for the regional GMV by age, gender and TIV using the controls'. There is no mention of using a pre-trained model from external sources.
nm1_model_origin.supporting_text: To account for the typical development of gray matter volume (GMV), we fitted a multivariate linear regression model for the regional GMV by age, gender and TIV using the controls.

nm2_modeling_method.reason: The paper describes the modeling method used.
nm2_modeling_method.supporting_text: To account for the typical development of gray matter volume (GMV), we fitted a multivariate linear regression model for the regional GMV by age, gender and TIV using the controls. ... we proposed an unsupervised algorithm, namely the RFHCC (random forest with homogeneous canonical correlation, Fig. 1).

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Identified four ASD subtypes with distinct brain–symptom association patterns; subtyping improved case–control AUC from 0.64 (no subtyping) to 0.75 (p<0.05), outperforming k-means subtyping (AUC 0.68).
